questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn about construction areas. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May turn left only on a green arrow.
May turn left on a green light when it is safe.
Must wait for the solid green light before you turn left.

questions.correctAnswerText: May turn left on a green light when it is safe.
questions.explanation: "Yield" means slow down and be ready to stop. Let any vehicles, cyclists, or pedestrians pass first. Then you may proceed with the sign's directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop then proceed when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop then proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop at the stop line. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop where you can see oncoming traffic. Proceed only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn about upcoming hazards. Round signs are used only to warn about railroad crossings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red and white triangular sign means you must yield the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and proceed with caution.
Come to a complete stop as quickly as possible.
Stop and proceed only when the intersection is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and proceed with caution. You do not need to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns about a steep or long downgrade ahead. The hill may have sharp curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn about upcoming conditions. This sign alerts you to prepare for traffic merging from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that traffic from the right will be merging into your lane. Be ready to slow down and make room for merging traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turn on red light permitted with caution.
All traffic must turn right at next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through it means the action shown is not allowed. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that a traffic light is ahead. Be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the divided highway is ending. You are entering a two-way road where traffic moves in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead may be slippery. Slow down because your car could lose traction and take longer to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you to watch for people crossing the road. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left at this location. It is unsafe and against the law.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow triangular sign marks an area where you cannot pass other vehicles. Road markings also show this restricted passing area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road will curve right first, then left. Slow down and be prepared for these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions ahead. This sign tells you to slow down and prepare for a sharp change in direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: The stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on any roadway. You must come to a complete stop. Do not proceed until the way is clear and you can safely pass through the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a change in direction or a narrowing road. You may see several of these signs on sharp curves or near narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Round signs always indicate a railroad crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange warning sign alerts you to roadwork ahead. Stay alert for temporary traffic control devices when driving through a work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings and alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns of a steep hill. Adjust your speed to avoid collisions and brake damage.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you the road will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Are traveling in the wrong direction.
Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
May not proceed until it changes to green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
questions.explanation: Treat a flashing red light like a stop sign. Come to a complete stop before entering the intersection. Yield to all other traffic and pedestrians.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is ahead.
